_note: Human-tier adjudication of the duplicate-proposition question, for pairs that content-token Jaccard provably cannot separate. `census_independence` unions these into its component counting; without them it reports a class fully independent while known duplicates sit inside it.

provenance.method: two independent blind adjudicators, fresh headless CLI sessions from bare directories, neither told which cases carried a prior label
provenance.controls: 5 of 24 cases carried a prior label; both parties recovered all five (3/3 recorded duplicates DUPLICATE, 2/2 owner-ruled-lawful DISTINCT)
provenance.population: all 24 live pairs sharing a byte-identical premise AND verdict -- the only shape in which two rows can assert one proposition

owner_ruling.question: do the two lawful rulings (eg-0465/eg-0592, eg-0486/eg-0614) extend to the six pairs the adjudicators split on?
owner_ruling.ruling: No. Both lawful pairs generalise OPPOSITE slots -- one drops the subject, the other the object -- so neither entails the other. Each of the six generalises one slot only, against the specific restatement, so one entails the other. The precedent's own stated ground does not reach them: they are duplicate propositions.
owner_ruling.effect: confirmed duplicates 8 -> 14; entailed independent propositions 102 -> 96; the range collapses to a point. No bar moves and no matrix number moves -- the ratified census is 110 entailed ROWS either way.
owner_ruling.reversal: one file: move the six rows carrying basis 'owner ruling 2026-08-14' back to `contested` and the range returns to [96, 102]. Both endpoints clear the stated 0.90, so no gate decision depends on this ruling.
